profile.headline: .NET Full Stack Developer
profile.geoLocationName: Queens County, New York, United States
profile.summary: Accomplished Software Developer with progressive experience in all facets of application development, project management, and software development life cycle. Highly skilled in collaborating with all members of the organization to achieve technical objectives. Comprehensive background in all phases of software development life cycle using Agile Methodologies. Adept in enhancing productivity levels, introducing process improvements, and reducing costs. Technical proficiency in C/C++, C#, SQL, and ASP.NET MVC.

positions.title: .NET Developer
positions.locationName: Melville, New York, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Fullstack .NET Developer for an e-commerce application with a web based store front and order management using Kanban Agile framework.
• Modernized a legacy .NET Framework application by integrating dependency injection and C# 12, resulting in a 15% increase in unit test coverage and improved code maintainability and efficiency.
• Designed, implemented, and optimized complex SQL database schemas and stored procedures to significantly enhance the e-commerce platform’s data retrieval efficiency and ensure high scalability.
• Collaborated with product managers and designers to translate business requirements into technical specifications and user stories, ensuring alignment and successful feature delivery.
• Troubleshooted and resolved critical production issues, including during high-traffic periods like holiday sales, ensuring minimal downtime and optimal system performance.
• Integrated various payment gateways (Authorize.NET, Adyen, Bolt, etc), enabling secure and diverse transaction processing for the e-commerce platform.
• Unified shipping providers (UPS and FedEx) to use proprietary Back Office APIs to shorten the migration of deprecated APIs.
• Contributed to the continuous improvement of the development process by implementing and optimizing CI/CD Jenkins pipelines and automated testing strategies leading to faster and more reliable deployments.
positions.insights: Skills: ASPX · .NET Architecture · .NET Core · Azure SQL · Microsoft Azure

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Developer for a web-based application using React, GraphQL, REST, Azure Digital Twin, IoT Hub, Azure Data Explorer, and Azure SQL Database. AI-Twin provides a digital twin model of office buildings to enable engineers to visualize and drive energy savings.
•	Implemented .NET GraphQL to bridge and cache Azure Digital Twins and Azure Data Explorer services to the gateway
•	Designed and implemented user management system for frontend and backend using React, Apollo, NodeJS, and .NET
•	Created software configurable simulation of BACnet devices for non-production environment and saved company from purchasing hardware for testing
•	Implemented Azure Functions with durable orchestration in .NET to lake data from third party services
positions.insights: Skills: REST APIs · C# · GraphQL · TypeScript · ASP.NET · React.js · Node.js

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
Developing eCommerce web applications using iAPPS Pro Bridgeline Framework
•	Migrated ASP.NET MVC Razor to Angular 6.0 with Angular CLI
•	Implemented Accelerated Mobile Pages for core framework using Node JS with Gulp, SASS, and UnCSS to keep CSS under 50KB per page
•	Designing and creating eCommerce application using .NET stack (ASP.NET Web Forms/Web API, WCF, MVC, XSLT, JavaScript)
•	Created web-based database migration application to allow clients to upgrade their database using ASP.NET MVC, AngularJS, SignalR
•	Implemented Elastic Search to allow site indexing and searching

positions.title: Senior Application Developer
positions.description:
Developing applications for two different clients and main application
•	Front end work for Vitralogy’s main application with Angular 2 using Visual Code, Kendo, NPM, and Node JS 
•	Complete ownership of applications for IMP (front and back-end implementation), allowing the committee to audit practitioners using ASP.NET MVC, Razor, Kendo UI, Angular JS, and third-party JavaScript libraries
•	Enhancing current work order platform application hosted on Azure with a local Great Plains accounting system

positions.title: Senior Application Developer
positions.description:
Designed and developed web based application using full stack web development that includes but not limited to Entity Framework, Razor, JavaScript, CSS, MVC, and MS SQL.
• Spearheaded a web based application for asset management using Kendo UI for grid and controls, Entity Framework, and MVC.
• Maintain and add new features to current legacy ASP code using VBScript, JavaScipt, and DHTMLX for control elements.
• Currently migrating legacy ASP code to a RESTful application for better scalability, stability and maintainability using Web API and AngularJS.
• Created and maintained SSRS reports
• Successfully delivered many projects as an agile architect

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Used Kanban and disciplined agile delivery to support and enhance Endur product line
• Implemented solutions for capturing liquid commodity trade and logistics using mainly C, Oracle SQL, and OpenLink’s proprietary Javascript based language OpenJVS.
• Increased product stability by creating unit tests for all new enhancements.

positions.title: Technical Specialist
positions.description:
•	Helped sustain Total Defense for Business r14 with support for the sale teams’ high priority clients where sales and renewals were dependent on issue resolution
•	Solely responsible for the entire software engineering maintenance of Groupware Options (Exchange Option, SharePoint Option, Domino Option, and NetApp Option) enterprise security products
•	Wrote migration software in C# .NET allowing product to seamlessly upgrade from Windows 7 to Windows 8
•	Updated product, using CSS, Javascript, and appropriate SDK’s, to be compatible with the latest browsers

company.name: Total Defense Inc. (former division of CA Technologies)

positions.title: Sr Project Lead
positions.locationName: Hauppauge, NY (former division of CA Technologies)
positions.description:
•	Guided an off-shore team of 3 to 4 developers and coordinated with QA, localization, technical publications, support, and other project leads for Groupware Options
•	Actively participated in cross functional calls, conducted project sizing, and scheduling that led to 5 major releases to market
•	Improved product defects and code reviews by conducting product quality assurance (PQA) 
•	Coordinated data prevention analysis that made sure source of defects were identified and prevented
•	Wrote the design document specification for Groupware Options
Development accomplishments:
•	Solely developed and maintained the Exchange Option product line.
•	Created and designed database layer using SQLite3 to keep track and query all relevant details for real-time, on-demand, and scheduled scans
•	Created the multithreaded wrapper module for the antimalware software developers’ kit used in the entire Groupware Options product line.
•	Created module in C++/CLI to bridge unmanaged code with Exchange Web Service for Exchange 2007/2010 in Total Defense r12 for Exchange Option’s on-demand/scheduled scanning.
•	Increased Groupwares’ scanning performance of over 50%  by introducing in-memory scan instead of on disk

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
•	Solely developed and maintained (design, implementation, installation, unit testing, etc.) Exchange Option from InocuLAN 4.5 to eTrust InoculateIT 8.1 (six software development life cycles) for 9+ years
•	Created ADO.NET module using C++/CLI to allow greater configuration granularity by allowing users to enumerate and select MS Exchange database and mailboxes.
•	Redesigned Exchange Option to be completely object oriented in C++ and allowed a larger sharing code base with other team members.
•	Successfully integrated acquired technology to include antivirus and anti-spyware scanning in a single pass.

positions.title: Jr Programmer
positions.description:
•	Debugged crash dumps in Netware for memory corruption and dead locks
•	Certified InocuLAN 4.5 and InoculateIT 6.0 for Netware 4.5 to 6.0 by making sure code coverage was over 80%. This included but not limited to function coverage, statement coverage, condition statement, and state coverage.
